usage: Commonly used for fever and mild to moderate pain relief.
dosage: 1-2 tablets up to 4 times a day. Keep 4 hours gap between doses. Consult a professional.
warnings: Do not take with other Paracetamol products.
Excessive use can lead to liver failure.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Used for relief of pain and inflammation in conditions like joint pain, back pain, and muscle ache.
dosage: One tablet twice daily after food. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Caution in patients with stomach ulcers or heart disease.
May cause kidney problems with long-term use.

usage: Antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections of the respiratory tract, urinary tract, and skin.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet twice daily. Complete the full course as prescribed.
warnings: Notify doctor of any previous allergy to Cephalosporins.
Monitor for signs of superinfection.

usage: Broad-spectrum antibiotic for treating bacterial infections in lungs, ear, sinus, and urinary tract.
dosage: One tablet twice daily after food. Follow the doctor's full course instructions.
warnings: Allergic reactions to Penicillin are common.
Watch for liver-related side effects.
storage: Keep in a cool and dry place.

usage: Used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension) and reduce risk of heart attack or stroke.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily at a fixed time. Consult your doctor.
warnings: Not for use during pregnancy as it can harm the fetus.
Monitor blood pressure and kidney function regularly.

manufacturer: J B Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Ltd
usage: Used for treatment of hypertension (high blood pressure).
dosage: One tablet daily as prescribed. Consult a physician.
warnings: May cause a sudden drop in blood pressure if taken with other BP meds.
Consult doctor before stopping.
storage: Store in a cool place away from light.

usage: Used to treat symptoms of GERD, stomach ulcers, and excessive acid production.
dosage: Usually one capsule daily in the morning on an empty stomach. Consult your doctor.
warnings: Long-term use may lead to bone fractures or low magnesium levels.
Inform doctor of liver issues.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.

usage: Helps in reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily before food. Seek professional advice.
warnings: Inform doctor if you are allergic to proton pump inhibitors.
May interact with antifungal medicines.

usage: Combination medicine to improve blood sugar control in Type 2 diabetes patients.
dosage: One tablet twice daily with meals. Follow doctor's prescription carefully.
warnings: Risk of lactic acidosis due to Metformin component.
Monitor kidney function and blood sugar levels.

Avoid alcohol.
storage: Keep away from children. Store below 25°C.

usage: Lowers bad cholesterol and triglycerides and raises good cholesterol.
dosage: Usually once daily at night. Follow doctor's orders.
warnings: Risk of muscle damage (myopathy) especially at high doses.
Inform doctor of kidney issues.

usage: Used as a blood thinner to prevent heart attacks, strokes, and blood clots.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily. Consult your doctor for specific use.

usage: Supports healthy nervous system and treats Vitamin B deficiencies.

Caution in patients with severe kidney disease.

usage: Supplement for muscle health, skin health, and Vitamin E deficiency.

warnings: Avoid long-term high doses without medical supervision.

storage: Keep the bottle tightly closed. Store at room temperature.

Do not cover with tight bandages unless advised by a doctor.
